title: Sport and Personal Drive Modes
summary: Feedback about drive modes centers on customers enjoying the feel of Sport mode while many other mentions are informational requests or customization discussions rather than clear evaluations.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise Sport mode for a stronger driving feel, enjoyable sensation, and in one case stronger regeneration behavior.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe missing expected behavior in Sport mode or note that using Sport mode only reduces how often another problem appears rather than resolving it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly discuss how to use, compare, or customize Sport and Personal modes without stating a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: Most topic mentions are undetermined, so clear evaluative evidence is limited.
The sampled fragments include informational, preference, workaround, and feature-request comments, which limits how specifically the topic can be summarized.
One supplied positive example contains text that reads as critical, so sentiment labels and fragment wording are not always aligned in the sample.
